innervation.root_levels: T7-T12 (thoracoabdominal + subcostal nerves, one segment innervated per tendinous-intersection compartment)

actions: compresses abdominal contents / raises intra-abdominal pressure

functional_compartments.name: Segment 1 (superior, costal)
functional_compartments.function_note: Most cranial of the muscle's tendinous-intersection-bounded segments; a textbook example of a single named muscle subdivided into separately-innervated, individually-contractile compartments.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

functional_compartments.name: Segment 2
functional_compartments.function_note: Second segment, bounded above and below by tendinous intersections that adhere firmly to the anterior rectus sheath.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

functional_compartments.name: Segment 3
functional_compartments.function_note: Third segment, roughly at the level of the umbilicus.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

functional_compartments.name: Segment 4 (inferior, pubic)
functional_compartments.function_note: Longest, most caudal segment (intersections are not present below the umbilicus in most individuals) running to the pubic attachment.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
